title: The 13:00 decided nothing on the record, and the 16:00 sign-off is at 1 of 7
headline: The busiest two hours yet: 28 agent commits since brief 7, most of them the vault agents of Vicky, Angelo and Jose. Vicky is the first person fully wired (L6, 9 of 9): her own vault is open in her page. But no decision from the 13:00 stand-up is on the record, and team-collaboration@web-summit.angelo is still waiting for a transcript at 14:16, so everything carries over to 18:00. The print sign-off due at 16:00 has 1 of 7 sets signed (Vicky), and the hoodie and card wait on you.

for_you.ask: What did the 13:00 decide? Your words, or the transcript
for_you.detail: Nothing was recorded (WS-107, WS-96). Tell me the decisions in a line each, as you said them, or share the transcript with Angelo's account; I record each with agenda.mjs decide, in your words, with where and when. Nothing is recorded for you without them.
options: the decisions in a message to me
for_you.recommend: A message to me now: one line per decision.

for_you.ask: The print sign-off: the hoodie, the card and your own set before 16:00 (WS-113)
for_you.detail: Signed: Vicky. Waiting: Dinis, Silvio, Nimay, Angelo, Indi, Jose; the hoodie H1 and the card C1 are yours to sign. You may sign for anyone on their word. The printer needs confirmation by the end of today.
options: sign now, and for the others on their word
for_you.recommend: Sign the shared designs now and ask each person's agent to sign theirs by 18:00.
